subject: Infra squad capacity & offer negotiation for open infra eng roles
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Infra squad capacity — aligning offers for SRE candidates

Team,

Quick summary: we have two strong pipeline candidates for the infra/SRE openings on the runtime squad — Marco (senior, L5) and Asha (mid, L4). Recruiting put together the attached comp matrix and the Q3 budget snapshot. We're currently approved for two FTEs at L4 base bands (budgeted headcount), but Marcus flagged that capacity demand for the next two sprints suggests we may need a single senior instead (less onboarding ramp, more ownership).

Questions for this thread:
- Are we comfortable moving budget from two L4s to one L5 (trade headcount for seniority)?
- If so, what is our approved top-of-band base + equity + signing bonus for L5 infra hires in US west?
- Can we offer recruiter's request (candidate-requested $20k sign-on) or prefer increased equity?

Attachments: candidate_comp_matrix.xlsx, budget_snapshot_q3.pdf

I want to finalize and send an offer to Marco by end of week if we land on numbers. Please reply with approvals or proposed changes.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Talent Planning — Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Infra squad capacity — aligning offers for SRE candidates

Naomi,

I support swapping two L4 hires for one L5. The runtime backlog and on-call gaps mean a senior will unblock more tickets and reduce firefighting time. Numbers thoughts: top-of-band L5 base for US-west is $205k; current equity guidelines would be ~0.25% for L5 ICs (refresh/RSU mix depending on tenure).

On signing bonus: I'd rather avoid a large cash sign-on if possible. If the candidate is firm on cash, approve up to $15k on a pro-rated basis (one-time, contingent on 90-day retention). If recruiting says the candidate will decline without $20k, we can revisit.

Also recommend adding a 6-month performance milestone tied to a partial retention payout (keeps cost predictable).

Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Infrastructure

All — a few legal/comp notes from my side:
1) Compensation bands: Legal & People have approved base up to $210k at L5 for exceptional hires, but this must be documented with rationale and sign-off from hiring manager.
2) Signing bonus vs equity: We prefer equity bumps over large cash sign-ons where possible. If we do a sign-on, structure it as 50% at start + 50% after 12 months, and include the conditional retention clause Marcus suggested.
3) Offer template: I've redlined the standard offer template for infra roles (attached). Please do not promise start date before background + I-9 completion.

Attachment: redline_offer_template.docx

Grace O'Connor
Head of People Operations (Legal partner)

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, offerops@hirefast.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Offer approach for Marco Ruiz (Infra SRE) — Redwood Inference

Marco / Asha — looping you into the internal alignment so you have visibility on next steps.

Decision summary (internal approvals in thread):
- We will convert the two budgeted L4 slots into one L5 hire for the runtime infra squad.
- Offer to extend to Marco Ruiz at L5 (Senior Infra Engineer) with the following package: base $208,000; RSU grant target 0.26% (4-year vesting); signing bonus $15,000 paid 50% at start, 50% at 12 months; conditional 6-month milestone payout of $5,000 tied to on-call ownership and project delivery.
- Background check and standard I-9 required; start date flexible but preferred August 2, 2027.

Marco: please confirm that the above is acceptable in principle. If yes, offer ops (cc'd) will prepare an offer packet and DocuSign envelope (link below) for your review. We will include the redlined template Grace provided.

DocuSign (prelim): https://app.docusign.com/Signing/Start?envelopeId=abc123-offer-marco
Attachment: candidate_comp_matrix.xlsx, budget_snapshot_q3.pdf

If Marco declines, we will revert to making two L4 offers and loop recruiting to re-run the comp math.

Thanks all — Naomi
